WITH matched_records AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(q.qualregistry) as cnt
  FROM scanqc q
  INNER JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_qc, COUNT(*) as num_groups
  FROM matched_records
)
SELECT 
  m.fundflux,
  m.cnt as qc_count,
  m.cnt * 1.0 / t.total_qc as fraction,
  m.cnt * 1.0 / (t.total_qc * 1.0 / t.num_groups) as ratio_to_avg
FROM matched_records m
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY m.fundflux
